file_reviews.assessment: Full manuscript inspected. Section 2.2 establishes functorial aggregation monotonicity under coboundary commutation and operator contraction (Theorem 2.1). Section 4.4 establishes the cycle additivity criterion via a common dual circulation maximizer (Proposition 4.6), and Section 4.10 establishes KKT necessity for the l1 quotient problem (Theorem 4.14).
Claim ledger inspected. C1 (Theorem 2.1 functorial aggregation monotonicity), C6 (Proposition 4.6 cycle additivity criterion), and C13 (Theorem 4.14 KKT variational principle) verified.
Core module inspected. Implements ExactTwoPhaseSimplexSolver, LocalPrimalDualIterator.is_kkt_fixed_point, and FunctorialAggregation.pushforward_cochain.
Test suite inspected. Contains test_functorial_aggregation_monotonicity, test_overlapping_cycle_holonomy_counterexample, and test_kkt_fixed_point_verification.

claims.statement: If A o d0^P = d0^Q o pi_* and ||A||_{l1 -> l1} <= 1 then ||d0^Q pi_* s||_1 <= ||d0^P s||_1 for every section s.
dependencies: Finite cochain spaces with stalkwise l1 norms.
Coboundary commutation identity A o d0^P = d0^Q o pi_*.
Global l1 operator contraction bound ||A||_{l1 -> l1} <= 1.
claims.limits: Applies to finite complexes and contractive coboundary-commuting aggregations; zero coarse defect does not certify zero fine defect without a faithfulness condition.

claims.statement: Phi_w(omega_1 + omega_2) = Phi_w(omega_1) + Phi_w(omega_2) iff some z in Z_w = {d0^* z = 0, |z_e| <= w_e} maximizes both <z, omega_1> and <z, omega_2>.
dependencies: Finite scalar graph complex with strictly positive edge weights.
Quotient defect norm definition Phi_w(omega) = min_f ||omega - d0 f||_{1, w}.
Linear programming strong duality on finite polyhedral complexes.
claims.limits: Applies to finite graph complexes with positive weights; strict subadditivity occurs when cycles share edges with conflicting orientation requirements.

claims.statement: If s minimizes ||omega - d0 s||_1 on a finite graph with positive weights, then some phi in partial ||omega - d0 s||_1 satisfies d0^* phi = 0.
dependencies: Finite graph complex with strictly positive edge weights.
Convex subdifferential chain rule for affine compositions.
First-order optimality condition 0 in partial J(s) for unconstrained convex minimization.
claims.limits: Applies to finite graphs with positive weights; the certifying circulation phi is non-unique on coordinates where the residual vanishes.
